title: Title
subtitle: Create once. Manage every connected platform from one place.
draft_hint: Save at any stage. Portal requirements are checked before publication.
photos_hint: Upload once, reuse across platforms. The first photo is your cover.
requirements_hint: Required fields depend on the selected platform. Saving a draft is always free.
ai_review: Review and edit this suggestion before applying it.
empty_body: Save a draft, add your photos and choose the platforms you want to reach.
connection_hint: Sign in directly on the platform. HOMATCH never asks for your password.
capability_pending: Portal operations await independent live verification.
install_help: In Chrome, open chrome://extensions, enable Developer mode and load the reviewed publishing-extension folder using Load unpacked. After an update, replace that folder, click Reload and reload HOMATCH and your portal tabs. Sign in on the portal, then return here and check the connection.
browser_required: Queued operations wait for your authorized browser session. Remote success is shown only after verification.
queue_confirm: Queue this operation for the following platforms?
remote_confirm: Review the listing in the portal tab. Confirm only if you approve this exact remote action.
bulk_confirm: Confirm the selected operation for {n} listings? Results are tracked separately for each platform.
activation_confirm: Activate this listing for {n} credits every 24 hours? The first charge follows verified publication. Drafts are free.
archive_confirm: Archive this property? Unresolved remote listings must be managed first.
error_extension: Install or update the HOMATCH publishing extension, then reload this page.
error_auth: Sign in on the selected platform and check the connection again.
error_capability: This platform operation is not yet live verified and remains disabled.
error_reconcile: The remote result needs checking. Do not repeat the action until it is reconciled.
error_conflict: This draft changed elsewhere. Reload it before saving again.
error_balance: Check your credit balance and listing activation before continuing.
error_price: The daily price changed. Review and confirm the current price.
error_validation: Complete the selected platform’s required fields before publishing.
error_ai_limit: Today’s writing limit has been reached. Try again tomorrow.
error_ai: The description could not be generated. Your existing text is safe.
error_remote: Resolve external listings before archiving this property.
error_photo: Check the image format, size and photo count, then try again.
error_generic: We could not complete this request. Try again or contact support.
billing_policy: Drafts are free. One daily charge covers all selected platforms. Billing begins after verified publication and runs in UTC 24-hour periods. Fully paused listings stop renewing after the paid period. Partial pauses remain billable. Insufficient credits stop new paid actions; external listings remain visible until a portal confirms otherwise.
admin_hint: Inspect publishing health, subscriptions and audit history without exposing portal sessions.
admin_config_confirm: Save these publishing billing settings? Existing price consent remains protected.
